addr: 754, Shri Krishna Temple Rd, next to HDFC Bank, Kalyan Nagar, Indira Nagar 1st Stage, Stage 1, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038, India

rev.t: I have been visiting cake walk for years now. Quality and taste has remained the same over the years. Cakes n savories are so yummy. Chicken quiche and chicken puff have been my top orders and i enjoy the red velvet cake too. Well maintained over the years.

Cakewalk  is a delightful spot for anyone looking to indulge in tasty treats. They are especially known for their cakes, which are not only visually appealing but also of excellent quality, offering a perfect balance of flavor and texture. …
Recently visited Cake Walk Café in Indiranagar, and it was such a delightful experience! The place has a cozy and inviting vibe — perfect for catching up with friends or enjoying some quiet time. …
